content: Gary Larson’s comic strip The Far Side broke the mold of traditional newspaper comics by not having a recurring cast of characters. Peanuts had Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Linus and the rest of the gang. Garfield had Garfield, Odie, Jon, and some others. Calvin and Hobbes had Calvin, Hobbes, and Calvin’s parents. But The Far Side introduced new characters and scenarios every single day.
